name: Robert F. Kennedy
moments: He predicts the Democrats' investigations (Hegseth, Lutnick, Noem, RFK Jr., ambassadors, DOGE) will find 'a lot of criminal stuff' and swallow the administration, 'the non-survivable event' rather than the war or the economy. He says it will hurt more because voters feel the economy is bad whatever the fundamentals, and that he increasingly sees Vance as non-viable for 2028, a view he says is shared in Vance's own camp.
self

He says Senate and House Democrats are already sending letters across the private sector (on Lutnick, RFK Jr. and Kimberly Guilfoyle, Lewandowski and Noem) and summarizes, then reads, the Reuters report: Senator Maggie Hassan is investigating whether Vance helped Vitol trader John Addison, a donor to his 2022 Senate race and to pro-Trump PACs in 2024, win the Venezuelan oil sales after a December 2025 meeting at Montana's Yellowstone Club. He calls the two-week sequence a no-bid kickback to cronies, 'the definition of pay to play'.
mixed

He says the administration governs by press release (DHS tweets, Tulsi Gabbard, the Epstein binders, RFK Jr.'s food pyramid) and that the midterm clock was always going to run out. He argues Trump could have broken all the rules, as Stalin-style leaders do, and blew it by deferring to courts.
self

As guests arrive, he notes RFK Jr.'s statement calling anti-Semitism a public health emergency and the threat to Columbia's funding, and contrasts $12 billion more for Israel with frozen aid elsewhere, as the Gaza ceasefire and Syria operations loom.
self

He says Republicans will tell voters in 2026 and 2028 that there is no alternative, and cites his own record of urging non-voting since 2019. He argues for taking your own side, citing RFK Jr. and European parties like the AfD, and says the Trump movement was skin-suited by imitators.
self
He reacts to Trump declassifying the JFK and RFK files but not MLK or Epstein, and sets up the Vivek Ramaswamy H-1B story.
self

He says people forget the real objectives, a Zionist-occupied government to depose and mass immigration reducing whiteness, being distracted by RFK Jr.'s food issues and healthcare, and says deportation would lower costs.
self

He says Hegseth's troubled nomination is dragging down other Trump picks like Gabbard, Patel and RFK Jr. in betting markets, says the cabinet is mostly bad, and says he is personally profiting from crypto under Trump.
self

He says Tulsi Gabbard and RFK will likely also fail, recounts the recess-appointment cope, and argues that if Republicans could not back Gaetz they will not back deportations. He portrays Trump as old, tired and apathetic, not a Caesar who will break the establishment.
self

He says he is ambivalent about Gaetz, suspecting he is compromised or blackmailed, and complains that Trump's appointees (RFK, Hegseth, Huckabee, Gabbard) are freaks or neocons. He says he wants clean intelligent white people running things and sounds uneasy about the administration.
